content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Devon: yo you up
Me: yeah just folding laundry, cat is supervising as usual
Devon: lol of course, clean load?
Me: obviously, she only sits on clean
Devon: mine is currently screaming at me for treats
Me: give her like one so she leaves you alone
Devon: I did, now she wants more
Me: classic
Devon: hey random question, what was the street Luigi's was on?
Me: 5th right? like by the bank construction?
Devon: yeah I thought so but I was scrolling back to double check
Devon: found it way back from sept 16, I had said "like Luigi's on 5th Street?"
Me: lol that was forever ago
Devon: right, then I said "lol same, 6 pm work?" right after
Devon: that was the first friday plan, not trying to plan it again btw
Me: oh good cause I'm still full from yesterday lol
Devon: same, those pepperoni slices at Mario's were massive
Me: huge, I still have a slice in the fridge
Devon: me too, gonna try that pan trick again for dinner
Me: oh yeah with the water splash and lid?
Devon: yep, way better than microwave
Me: did you end up reheating the Rosa's leftovers like that last time?
Devon: nah that thin crust was gone same night
Me: fair, that margherita didn't stand a chance
Devon: coworker asked where Luigi's was so I needed the street name
Me: oh tell them parking in back like last time
Devon: yeah I told them back lot is easier
Me: traffic still bad over there this afternoon?
Devon: I haven't gone out yet, still in sweatpants
Me: same, I was gonna run to the store in a bit
Devon: you still low on snacks from the other day?
Me: yeah I never went, ended up just eating that frozen lemon pepper chicken
Devon: oh the stuff you froze last week?
Me: yep, still holds up
Devon: nice, better than my toast era
Me: hey peanut butter toast is elite don't hate
Devon: lol true, had it again this morning
Me: you talk to your mom today?
Devon: yeah she texted this afternoon about lunch tomorrow
Me: oh is she doing the potato salad again?
Devon: she said she'll make extra cause you're probably coming
Me: tell her I love her, I'll come by after noon-ish
Devon: will do, she still brings up you demolishing it last time
Me: I have no regrets, it was that good
Devon: zero self control, like us with garlic knots
Me: literally those didn't even make it home
Devon: I ate mine in the car, no shame
Devon: anyway thanks for confirming 5th, I sent it to my coworker
Me: no problem, you doing anything else today?
Devon: gotta help mom with a quick grocery run later actually
Me: again? didn't you just stock up last weekend
Devon: yeah but she made a mile long list again
Me: lol of course, want help?
Devon: nah I got it, should be quick this afternoon
Me: ok, I'm gonna brave the store too before it gets busy
Devon: good luck, text me if 5th is still blocked by the bank
Me: will do, I'll go oak instead if it is
Devon: smart, okay cat is attacking my charger gotta go
Me: lol go feed the beast
Devon: brb",
  "writer_note": "Set the chat on Saturday afternoon after the Mario's Friday to make the September 16 Luigi's quote clearly old, and had Devon cite the exact date and wording while explicitly saying he wasn't re-planning it, just passing the street name to a coworker."
}
